description:
Job Title: Business Intelligence (BI) Developer / Business Systems Analyst 
 Duration: 12 Months 
 Location: Oakbrook Terrace, IL 
 Responsibilities: 
 Maintain existing in-house developed methods to access, analyze, organize, and present data. Work with stakeholders to identify user needs. Plan, analyze, design, build, test, and implement solutions to address user needs. Perform technical and analytical services involving database performance and tuning, and business process analysis and design to resolve data and reporting needs. Administer a variety of database systems and applications including MS Access, SQL Server, Primavera, and WinEst. Test and coordinate modifications to new or existing systems and applications. Create and maintain reporting systems. Troubleshoot and correct issues as they arise. Ensure databases and systems are executing optimally. Add new users to systems as needed. Enhance or build data models as needed. Create and modify job aids, user reference and/ or technical materials for existing or newly developed systems. 
 
 Technical Skills: 
 Operating Systems / Platforms: Windows Desktop; Windows Server; Visual Studio; Team Foundation Server; .NET; HTML; ADO.NET; ODBC 
 DBMS: MS SQL Server; MS Access; Oracle; Hyperion 
 Software: Crystal Reports; SSRS; SSAS; SSIS; MS Office Suite 
 Languages: VB.Net; VBA; LINQ
